title: Control store design
text: CP-01/02/03: shared control storage and node registry 中文. Establish the contract before implementation/acceptance. Node visibility alone does not provide global task control. Standalone local mode remains the default. Explicit cluster configuration selects a separate SQL control namespace: PostgreSQL/MySQL initially, with H2 for protocol tests. Control metadata and CDC journals/business targets have different roles; separate namespaces may reuse an SQL instance. Use dedicated credentials and bounded connections/queries; never expose connection URLs, credentials or business data in the UI. rmc cluster stores clusterId, protocol format and a consistent lease duration. Incompatible settings refuse startup. rmc node stores stable nodeId, process incarnation, registration epoch, database-clock heartbeat/lease, lifecycle state and actual version/JVM/architecture/capacity. Registration serializes capacity checks on the cluster row. Another process cannot overwrite an active nodeId. Heartbeat and shutdown check incarnation/epoch so stale processes cannot renew or change a replacement's row. Database time determines expiry. rmc node task initially contains only whitelisted observations: task ID, revision, desired/Worker state and observation time. It is not global task authority and cannot authorize scheduling/recovery. Duplicate observed task IDs indicate a conflict; they do not establish uniqueness or failover. Global configuration/commands, idempotent receipts, execution fencing, shared accounts/audit and shared sessions remain CP-02/03/04/05/07 and SE-04 work. Registry reads use a consistent database snapshot and return observation time, heartbeat, expiry, HEALTHY/STALE/STOPPED, epoch and real version/JVM/architecture/CPU/heap/configured capacity. Keyset pagination and bounded node/task counts limit responses. Expired records remain visibly stale; storage failure returns503 rather than claiming cached health. Initially only ADMIN can inspect global node/task observations. VIEWER/OPERATOR retain existing task permissions. The UI distinguishes registry visibility from local task operations until remote commands are implemented. Filesystem paths, secrets and raw logs are excluded. Registry leases do not replace CDC/target Worker fencing. Startup validates/creates the control schema, registers and starts a bounded independent heartbeat thread. Graceful shutdown stops heartbeats and marks only its own incarnation STOPPED. Kill/power loss becomes STALE through database expiry. Control-store failure affects readiness and registry requests; existing Workers retain their journal lease behavior without global takeover commands. Acceptance covers independent local directories sharing the registry, concurrent registration, active-ID collision, expiry/replacement, stale heartbeat/shutdown refusal, server time/capacity/pagination, redaction and HTTP roles. Native PostgreSQL/MySQL two-node startup/kill/reopen/storage-outage checks, current artifact/UI and bilingual operations are required. Passing the registry closes only CP-01.

title: 共享控制库设计
text: CP-01/02/03：共享控制状态与节点目录 English。此文先固定协议合同，再实现和验收；节点目录完成不代表全局任务控制完成。 存储和身份 保留默认单机本地模式。显式启用 cluster 后使用单独 SQL 控制命名空间，首批为 PostgreSQL/MySQL；H2 用于协议测试。共享控制状态与业务目标/CDC 日志是不同职责，可按独立命名空间复用 SQL 实例。连接使用专用凭据、限时连接/查询，不把 URL、凭据或业务数据返回页面。 rmc cluster 记录 clusterId、协议格式和统一租约期限；同集群不兼容设置拒绝启动。 rmc node 记录稳定 nodeId、进程 incarnation、注册 epoch、数据库时钟心跳/租约、退出状态及版本/JVM/架构/容量。注册容量在集群行锁下检查；活动 nodeId 不允许另一进程覆盖。心跳和退出均校验 incarnation/epoch；旧进程不能续租或改写新进程记录。数据库时间是失联判定依据，客户端时钟不参与授权。 rmc node task 第一阶段仅保存白名单任务观察：任务ID、控制修订、期望状态、Worker状态、观察时间。它不是全局任务权威表，也不授权恢复/调度。重复 taskId 可在观察中显示冲突；不能靠该表声称全局唯一或执行接管。全局配置/命令、幂等回执、owner fencing、权限/审计与跨控制器会话在 CP-02/03/04/05/07 和 SE-04 后续实现。 节点视图 管理入口使用数据库一致快照查询同一节点目录，返回服务器观察时间、最近心跳、租约到期、HEALTHY/STALE/STOPPED、node epoch、真实版本/JVM/架构/CPU/堆和配置容量。节点及任务观察按节点ID游标分页，节点数量和每节点任务数有上限。过期记录明确标识，不删除成“没问题”，目录不可达返回503，不能把缓存视图当成健康。 第一阶段只向 ADMIN 提供全局节点/任务观察，保留 VIEWER/OPERATOR 原任务权限。页面清楚标识节点目录与本机任务操作范围；后续远端控制接入后再改变任务视图语义。独立节点配置/密钥/日志路径不写入目录。节点租约不替代现有 CDC/目标 Worker fencing。 生命周期及测试 启动建立/检查控制 schema，注册节点，启动有界独立心跳线程；关闭停止心跳并以本代身份标记 STOPPED。断电/kill 后由数据库租约判为 STALE。控制库中断时 readiness 失效，目录请求503；本阶段既有 Worker 继续遵循其同步日志租约，尚不接受全局接管命令。 验收包括：两个独立本地目录的服务读取同一节点目录；并发注册、活动ID碰撞、过期替换、旧进程续租/退出拒绝；数据库时间与容量；分页和无凭据投影；HTTP权限；真实 PostgreSQL/MySQL 双节点启动、kill/重开及控制库存储中断恢复；最新UI、制品及双语运维说明。目录观察通过后只关闭 CP-01，不关闭其他集群条目。

title: CP-07: management and execution lifecycle separation (separated profile accepted)
text: CP-07: management and execution lifecycle separation (separated profile accepted) Protocol4 implements independent CONTROLLER/AGENT and compatible COMBINED profiles.The declared LOCAL-journal profile completes CP-07 acceptance.Combined mode still owns HTTP and local Workers in one process;container termination affects its Workers.Only the explicit separated profile provides the tested independent lifecycle.Automatic execution takeover and the complete matrix remain separate. Responsibilities Provide explicit controller, execution-agent and compatible combined profiles. Controllers serve authorized APIs/sessions/configuration and submit queries without restoring local Workers. Agents retain the fixed-owner private directory, execute durable commands, publish observations and answer typed reads. Their probe endpoint must not expose administration APIs. Combined mode preserves the existing single-deployment experience. Roles describe responsibility, not tenant isolation. Agents remain in the trusted control domain with documented control-store/key/native-journal access. Workers still filter controller credentials. Adding a role string does not establish least-secret or OS isolation. Identity and upgrades Stable nodeId plus original private-directory UUID remain authoritative. Controllers cannot be execution owners; an old Agent binding cannot allow new tasks after a node changes to controller-only. Roles/execution capability must participate in the shared membership protocol so old members cannot bypass admission. Define mixed-version refusal, graceful-stop prerequisites, directory restoration, coordinated backup and rollback limits. Splitting an existing combined node preserves owner/checkpoints/targets/reports. Its directory belongs only to an Agent keeping the original nodeId. A controller-only node must refuse an existing execution directory with tasks. An empty directory does not authorize deleting historical authority. Fault semantics Controller exit/SIGKILL leaves independent Agent/Workers running when the selected journal/lease/target protocol permits it; other entries continue observation and durable admission. Losing every controller does not imply STOP. Agent exit still requires explicit stop/unknown/original-owner recovery rules. Automatic relocation and stale-Worker fencing remain CP-04. Control-store failure never falls back to local mutation. Continued CDC depends on native journal/fencing and requires actual tests. Heartbeat expiry does not prove Worker termination. Probes, close ordering and deadlines must not launch unobserved Workers. Minimum acceptance Two controller JVMs plus an independent Agent/Worker and real SQL business data: create through A for the Agent, query/control through B; kill A while CDC continues; lose every controller while verifying the declared data-plane policy; restore management with identical task/positions/reports. Revocation and control-store outages still reject invalid commands. Agent exit/kill/original-directory reopen, wrong roles/empty directories/old members need positive and negative cases. Document Linux/Docker/Helm/native process/storage profiles; live Kubernetes/CSI acceptance is separate. 中文 · Current global control 2026-11-17: protocol4 implementation and declared LOCAL-journal lifecycle accepted. Evidence. Current deployment instructions and remaining limits are in the operations guide.

title: CP-07：管理入口与执行生命周期分离（分离档案已验收）
text: CP-07：管理入口与执行生命周期分离（分离档案已验收） 协议4已实现独立CONTROLLER/AGENT及兼容COMBINED档案，并完成限定LOCAL日志档案的CP-07验收。组合进程仍同时承担HTTP和本机Worker管理，关闭其容器会影响本机Worker；只有显式分离档案具备本合同验证的独立生命周期。自动执行接管和完整矩阵仍单独追踪。 进程职责 提供显式管理入口、执行Agent及兼容组合档案。管理入口只有授权API/会话/配置与查询提交，不启动或恢复本机Worker；Agent持有固定owner私有目录，执行持久命令、发布观察和回答类型化只读查询，管理API不得暴露在Agent探针端口。组合档案保留现有单部署体验。 角色表示进程职责，不是多租户安全隔离。Agent仍在可信控制域，控制库/任务密钥与原生日志权限必须说明；Worker继续过滤控制凭据。不能因增加role字符串而声称已经实现最小密钥或操作系统隔离。 持久身份及升级 owner仍由稳定nodeId和原私有目录UUID绑定。管理节点不得被选为owner，历史Agent绑定不能使改成纯管理角色的节点继续接受任务。角色及可执行能力必须参与共享成员协议校验；旧成员不能绕过新规则创建无执行者的任务。升级必须定义混合版本拒绝、正常停止成员的条件、原目录恢复、备份及回退边界。 已有组合节点拆分时，不修改任务owner/断点/目标或报告身份；原执行目录只能交给保留原nodeId的Agent。含任务的目录不能以纯管理角色悄悄打开。控制节点没有任务目录不等于可以删除历史权威绑定。 故障语义 管理入口退出或强杀后，独立Agent及Worker在其受支持日志/租约/目标协议允许时继续；其他入口仍可查询、提交和观察持久命令。所有管理入口失联也不得让Agent猜测任务已停止。Agent退出仍需要明确停止/未知和原owner恢复语义，自动迁移及旧Worker隔离仍属CP-04。 共享控制库中断不得回退到本机修改。是否继续已有CDC取决于数据面日志和原生隔离，必须实测；节点心跳过期不证明Worker终止。探针、退出顺序及超时不能留下无人监管的新Worker。 最低验收 两个管理JVM加独立Agent/Worker和真实SQL业务：A创建给Agent、B查询/控制；杀A时CDC继续，杀全部管理入口时CDC按已声明策略继续；管理恢复后看到同一任务、位点与报告；跨入口撤销和控制库中断仍拒绝非法命令。Agent关闭、容器强杀、原目录重开、错误角色/空目录/旧成员均有正常及拒绝测试。Linux/Docker/Helm/原生YAML分别给出进程与存储配置；K8s/CSI实测独立登记。 English · 当前全局控制 2026-11-17: protocol4 implementation and declared LOCAL-journal lifecycle accepted. Evidence. Current deployment instructions and remaining limits are in the operations guide.

title: Global control design
text: CP-02/03: global task authority and durable commands Contract for the next implementation, not accepted capability. Build on shared identity/audit/registry and preserve standalone APIs. Shared SQL owns unique task IDs, encrypted immutable configuration versions, control revisions, desired state, operations/receipts and owner bindings. Local directories are Worker/log/report projections. Bind authenticated encryption to cluster/store/task/version and protect its key from Worker environments. Import preserves pipeline identity/positions; duplicate IDs/resource conflicts require review without clearing targets or renaming pipelines automatically. Distinguish accepted configuration from owner-applied configuration. Every endpoint authorizes against shared identity/task grants and atomically records revision/request-ID checked intent and command.202 means durable acceptance. Duplicate requests return one operation; changed payload/identity reuse is rejected. Agents persist dispatch request IDs and original local revisions before calling TaskService, then replay identical arguments/receipts after restart rather than guessing that a lost reply meant no execution. Route create/check/start/stop/pause/resume/target retry/validation/repair/cancellation. Serialize conflicting changes; cancellation can bypass the maintenance operation it cancels. Distinguish pending/running/success/refusal/failure/unknown. Offline-owner STOP is not confirmed stopped. Initially pin owner node and data-directory identity. Reusing a nodeId with different data cannot silently take over. Expired observations stay UNKNOWN/STALE with timestamps while intent/queues persist. Automatic cross-node failover/drain/scheduling and controller/Worker lifecycle separation remain CP-04/07. Provide filtered/keyset-paged global tasks/totals/owners/revisions/observations/results. Cross-endpoint configuration masking uses verifiable scoped secret references. Owner-specific preview/raw differences/plans use typed expiring authenticated-encrypted SQL requests/replies with current authorization and node-epoch checks; production SQL transport uses TLS. Never trust client-supplied actor/owner or expose secret values. Keep desired/active versions, old active configuration on failure and reviewable rejected proposals. Owner-local reports cannot migrate by moving cursors; offline reads refuse explicitly while durable async commands may wait. Acceptance: A creates for B; both see one revision; A controls B with actual process/SQL evidence; duplicate/revision/permission/cancel/lost-reply/restart cases avoid duplicate execution; configuration/history/secret references work across endpoints; offline state/STOP remain unknown/waiting; store/key/directory mismatch refusal, paging/capacity/state migration and bilingual runbooks. These results do not close automatic execution failover CP-04/07. Storage and dispatch details (not yet integrated/accepted) A protected independent random32-byte master key derives separate keys bound to cluster/store identity. AES-GCM random nonces and task/version AAD reject substitution; keyed configuration/request digests avoid enumerable password hashes. Reconstruct actor roles from shared IAM. Missing keys/authority, identity mismatches and incomplete catalogs never seed a replacement. SQL applies both node/task grants, counts and bounded pagination. Non-administrators receive public metadata; ADMIN configuration responses remain redacted. Global task quota differs from local task/worker capacity. External immutable restore detection remains LG-09. Use typed encrypted, expiring requests/replies in shared SQL for owner-only previews/reports; production SQL transport uses TLS. Bind replies to cluster/store/task/request/owner epoch, cap and promptly expire sensitive payloads, and never trust browser-supplied actor roles. Separate waiting, dispatched, locally persisted, executing and terminal states. Persist original local revision/request/body digest before dispatch; lost replies reconcile original receipts/operations rather than resubmitting a fresh revision. Cancellation bypasses the maintenance queue it must interrupt. A202 is durable acceptance, not a committed destination transaction. Owner node plus private directory identity pins execution. Control epochs do not fence existing Workers or replace native journal/target guards. Pod deletion, lost contact or lease expiry does not prove a Worker stopped; cross-node execution takeover remains CP-04/07. Owner implementation progress (global entry not exposed) AgentDirectory binds stable nodeId, private directory UUID and current registration lease using task-store-derived HMACs. Initialization audit receipts and authenticated root counts detect missing/reset state. Wrong directories, expired leases and old incarnations cannot claim commands. Admission and claim validate leases in SQL transactions, locking IAM, task authority, node lease, agent root, then command root. This does not authorize automatic Worker failover. DurableCommands persists PENDING, DISPATCHED, ACCEPTED, UNKNOWN and terminal states. Before local invocation it seals the exact original local TaskRequest/revision. OwnerExecution invokes LocalTaskPlane and reconciles actual TaskService receipts/operations; local acceptance is not execution success. Lost replies/reopen reuse the original request. Missing evidence plus changed local revision remains UNKNOWN. TASK BUSY/OPERATION PENDING wait without replacing revisions/request IDs. Outstanding local receipts are protected from ordinary500-entry pruning while the owner is active. Global mode must restore every outstanding pin before exposing local mutation APIs. These remain internal primitives: CP-02/03 do not close until public global routing and acceptance exist. Cancellation has a parent and reserved capacity. An undispatched parent is atomically CANCELLED; an uncertain dispatched parent is reconciled first; actual cancellation is dispatched after parent ACCEPTED. Service completion can record committed outcomes after actor revocation, while new execution rechecks shared identity revision and task/node grants. Queries and observations (runtime integration open) OwnerQueries uses an expiring encrypted SQL mailbox and rejects mutations/LIST. It checks identity before execution, publication and delivery and binds owner/directory/epoch. Limits are512KiB requests,1MiB responses and1–60second expiry; expired rows release capacity. PostgreSQL/MySQL native checks passed. GlobalTaskViews publishes bounded authenticated observations and returns UNKNOWN for offline/new-epoch/stale owners; original metric observedAt is retained separately from ownerObservedAt. GlobalTaskPlane has internal cross-entry create/owner lifecycle/grant/offline STOP tests. Configuration/history/restore, startup migration, public HTTP/UI and complete business-chain acceptance remain open; CP-02/03 stay incomplete. Operations and FAQ. Public runtime increment, 2026-11-17 The opt-in sharedTasks profile now wires public HTTP/UI, configuration/history, owner queries, encrypted observations and fixed-owner commands. Startup restores receipt protections, verifies active configuration and scans all outstanding STOP/PAUSE pages before allowing Workers to restore RUNNING intent. Local-busy operations may complete without starting a Worker ahead of the stop. Invalidated authorization releases the block; uncertain evidence does not. Legacy local-task import is refused rather than silently migrated. CP-02/03 remain PARTIAL pending complete business, fault and migration acceptance. See the operations guide for current activation and limits.

title: 全局控制设计
text: CP-02/03：全局任务权威与持久命令合同 此合同指导下一阶段实现，尚未验收。依赖已验证的共享身份、审计和节点目录；保留单机接口。 权威和迁移 共享SQL保存全局唯一taskId、配置版本/密文、控制修订、期望状态、操作/幂等回执及owner绑定。独立本地目录继续保存Worker文件、日志和本地报告，作为执行投影；API不把本机controller.json当全局任务清单。配置密文采用带版本与taskId/cluster/store绑定的认证加密；密钥通过受保护配置提供并禁止下发任务进程，数据库不保存明文主密钥。 全局控制显式启用并提升集群协议，正常停止旧成员后切换，拒绝仍提供本地任务权威的成员加入。导入旧任务时保留pipeline身份、已有断点和owner数据目录身份；重复taskId/目标资源冲突拒绝并要求审阅，不自动清空目标或改pipelineId。所有节点读取同一修订与配置历史。新配置“已接受”和owner“已应用”分开表达。 命令与执行 任一入口校验共享身份、任务授权、期望修订和全局请求ID，在同一事务记录命令与控制意图。202只表示持久接受。重复请求返回同一操作；不同正文/身份复用ID拒绝。Agent按owner/代次读取队列，先持久记录本机派发请求ID和原本机修订，再调用现有TaskService，重启后复用相同参数和本机回执；不以读取到新修订后重新发一遍来猜测上次未执行。 支持创建/检查/启停/暂停/恢复/目标重试/校验/修复及取消；一个任务的冲突修改串行。取消必须能够旁路被取消的维护任务等待队列，保留原有中断/回执规则。操作状态区分PENDING、执行中、成功、拒绝、失败和UNKNOWN。离线owner的STOP不能报告已经停止。 首阶段owner固定，记录稳定节点ID和私有数据目录身份；不同目录重用nodeId不能自动接管。观察过期时显示UNKNOWN/STALE及采集时间，保留控制意图和队列。自动跨节点接管、排空/调度、控制与Worker进程解耦需CP-04/07单独协议/测试；本阶段不借租约过期声称已确认旧Worker停机。 查询、配置与界面 任务页按节点/任务/状态过滤并游标分页，展示全局总数、owner、控制修订、最近观察与操作结果。全局配置编辑使用跨入口可验证的保密字段引用；服务端只返回掩码/引用，不返回明文密钥。涉及owner文件/连接的预览、原始差异和计划读取，使用共享SQL中的有期限、认证加密查询/响应通道，绑定集群、存储身份、任务、请求和节点代次；生产SQL连接使用TLS。避免把浏览器身份或业务值放进节点URL。只执行固定类型查询，敏感响应限额并短期清理，不信任浏览器传入的actor/owner。 配置变更保存desired/active版本及应用结果；失败保留旧有效配置和可审阅的新提案。报告/计划仍在owner目录时标记数据可达性，不能只移动游标。纯查询/预览owner离线会明确拒绝，持久异步控制可保持等待。所有用户写请求继续使用Origin/CSRF及当前共享权限，不因转发绕过检查。 验收 两个独立目录/入口：A创建给B，双方全局修订一致；A控制B检查/启停/校验/修复，实际进程/SQL行为可核验；重复/修订/授权/取消、丢失回复和owner重开恢复不双执行；配置/历史/保密字段可跨入口操作；节点掉线显示未知，离线停止命令保持等待；集群存储/密钥/数据目录身份不匹配拒绝；分页和容量预算；新旧状态迁移及双语场景/FAQ。CP-04/07的自动执行接管不会因这些用例通过而关闭。 存储与派发细则（待接入/验收） 配置密钥是独立的32字节随机主密钥，通过保护的环境引用/文件提供。按集群及存储身份派生不同用途密钥；AES-GCM随机nonce与任务/版本AAD阻止内容被换到其他任务。SQL配置/请求摘要使用HMAC，避免用可枚举的明文密码摘要。账号权限先从共享目录重建，不能仅信任传入角色字段。主密钥丢失、身份不匹配、缺失权威或不完整目录不能自动创建替代状态。 任务列表在SQL中应用节点与任务授权过滤、统计和有界分页；普通账号只读取公共概况，配置编辑仍需ADMIN且响应继续掩码。根计数/任务元数据校验保护意外删除与替换；协调备份回退的外部不可变检测仍属LG-09。全局任务数量与单节点任务/运行容量分别配置。 派发状态区分等待、已派发、本机已持久接受、操作执行中和终态。Agent在本机持久保存原请求ID、原本机修订及正文摘要后派发；返回丢失时先恢复本机回执/原操作，不用新修订重发。任务队列的冲突意图串行；取消拥有独立优先通道，不能被正在等待取消的校验/修复占住。目标已提交但本机/全局状态回复丢失依照原生事务凭据恢复，不把一次202作为落库成功。 固定owner节点加私有目录身份共同决定执行归属；数据库租约和节点代次只保护控制命令派发，不能代替Worker/journal/目标原生隔离。仅删除Pod、失联或心跳过期不证明旧Worker已经停止。跨节点执行接管必须另行验证CP-04/07。 执行端实现进展（可选固定owner公开入口） AgentDirectory将稳定nodeId绑定私有目录UUID和当前注册租约，使用共享任务存储派生的HMAC验证元数据。目录与审计初始化回执、根计数共同检查；缺失目录/根、替换目录、过期租约和旧incarnation都不能重新获得派发权限。租约检查与命令认领同一个SQL事务；锁序为IAM、任务权威、节点租约、Agent根、命令根。此绑定不是自动Worker接管协议。 DurableCommands保存PENDING、DISPATCHED、ACCEPTED、UNKNOWN及终态。首次派发前将原本机TaskRequest（包括本机修订）认证加密持久化。OwnerExecution复用这个请求调用LocalTaskPlane，查询实际TaskService回执/操作，不能把本机接受当作执行完成。全局回复丢失或控制器重开后先查原回执；缺少证据且修订已变化时保留UNKNOWN。暂时TASK BUSY/OPERATION PENDING继续等待，不更换修订或重新生成请求。 未确认的本机请求回执在执行端活动期间免于普通500条回收；启用全局入口时必须在开放API/本地修改前恢复所有活动请求保护。现已接入可选共享任务运行时；启动恢复先保护回执、验证配置，再分页识别待处理STOP/PAUSE，防止先恢复旧RUNNING。旧任务导入和完整验收仍未完成，因此CP-02/03保持PARTIAL。 取消命令有父请求与预留容量。父任务未派发时原子标记父CANCELLED及取消成功；父已派发但本机是否接受不明时，先恢复父回执；仅在父ACCEPTED后派发实际取消。完成后的真实执行结果由服务身份登记，即使原操作者的权限已撤销；尚未执行的新命令须重验共享账号修订与节点/任务授权。 查询和观察实现（已接入可选运行时） OwnerQueries使用有期限的SQL加密信箱，禁止修改/LIST。执行前、结果发布和读取时检查当前身份，绑定owner目录/代次；请求512KiB、响应1MiB，有效期1至60秒，过期删除释放容量。原生PG/MySQL均已验证。GlobalTaskViews以认证密文发布有界任务观察，离线/新代次/过期返回UNKNOWN，不沿用旧健康状态；保留本机指标observedAt，另给出ownerObservedAt。GlobalTaskPlane已通过跨入口创建、实际owner启停、按节点/任务授权、失联STOP等待等内部测试。配置编辑/历史恢复及公开HTTP/界面现已接入；旧任务启动迁移和完整真实业务/故障矩阵仍缺，不能关闭CP-02/03。 Operations and FAQ.

title: Session design
text: SE-01/02/03/05: single-controller session design 中文 · Specification · Operations This implementation closes reload recovery, single-controller session lifecycle, protected transport and existing API compatibility. SE-04 and the CP shared control authority remain unfinished; MemoryStore is not shared control storage. Restart requires sign-in again without changing task/account/audit storage formats. State and interfaces BrowserSessions.Store defines insert/find/touch/remove/close. The bounded in-memory implementation purges expired entries. Keys are SHA256 digests of256-bit random session IDs; values contain principal/directory revision, random CSRF value, last activity and absolute expiry. Raw session IDs and API tokens are not retained. Both session IDs and CSRF values use32-byte SecureRandom and unpadded URL-safe Base64. Every request checks the candidate session against the current TaskService account directory: user exists, is enabled and has the same directory revision. Any directory mutation strictly revokes all older sessions. Task commit retains existing currentActor revision checks. Explicit Bearer never falls back to cookies; two valid but different identities are rejected. Audit stores identity/outcome without authentication material. A future shared backend must provide atomic bounded creation, expiry/touch/revocation and consistent authorization checks integrated with shared accounts, audit and command authority. Replacing the interface with another Map or mounting a shared directory cannot close SE-04. The complete shared control-state contract and migration protocol remain CP-02 work; empty interfaces are not counted as implementation. HTTP and page contract POST /api/session requires Bearer, GET /api/session accepts Bearer or cookies, and POST /api/session/logout requires cookies. Production defaults use the Host prefix, Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Path=/ and no Domain. Explicit local HTTP uses a different cookie name. Proxy publicOrigin is the exact external origin; forwarded headers are not trusted. Cookie mutations require both Origin and CSRF checks. The proxy terminates production TLS. Startup restores the server session and grants without reading a saved token; invalid sessions show sign-in. Language preference is the only persistent Web Storage value. API requests carry a page-session generation so late responses cannot mutate a newer identity. Refresh locks also use generations, preventing an old refresh from blocking a new login. Sign-in, sign-out and reauthentication after self-token rotation use one authentication queue. Sign-out clears UI state immediately, waits behind outstanding login, obtains the current CSRF credential and revokes that cookie, including a delayed login result. BroadcastChannel sends only a sign-out signal; recipients clear state and queue revocation without broadcasting secrets. Server sign-out failures show bilingual retry guidance. A confirmed self-token rotation may exchange the newly saved token for a completely new session; the previous session remains invalid. Acceptance scope - Eight real HTTP contract tests cover restoration, Origin/CSRF refusal, roles, identity conflicts, no fallback, directory-wide revocation, rotation/disable/grant changes, self-rotation, disabled sessions, restart invalidation, expiry/capacity and configuration validation. - Those eight tests run against the same candidate JAR on Java8/11/17/21/25. This is a session profile, not the full source/target/JDK matrix. - A TLS proxy and real CookieJar verify HTTPS cookies, withholding Secure credentials on HTTP, CSRF/Origin refusal, replay refusal after logout, Bearer compatibility and absence of plaintext credentials in state. - DOM coverage includes reload/new pages, sign-out, multiple tabs, late401/login/refresh, failed server sign-out and self-token rotation, preserving editor/audit/validation/repair tests. - Artifact checks, root and artifact-first tests, Helm/native parity and the updated Docker preview are archived separately. Full-browser visual/accessibility, live Kubernetes/CSI, shared controllers/sessions, OIDC and human-inactivity detection remain outside this acceptance. Historical gaps stay open.

title: 会话设计
text: SE-01/02/03/05：单控制节点会话设计 English · 需求 · 操作手册 本实现关闭浏览器刷新保持、单控制器会话生命周期、安全传输和现有 API 兼容四项。SE-04 共享会话与 CP 全局控制权威状态继续保留为未完成；MemoryStore 不是共享控制存储。控制器重启要求重新登录，不修改任务、账号或审计存储格式。 状态与接口 BrowserSessions.Store 定义 insert/find/touch/remove/close；当前实现为带最大容量、过期清理的内存映射。键为256位随机会话 ID 的 SHA256；值为身份快照、目录修订、CSRF 随机值、最后访问时间与绝对期限。不保留原始会话 ID 或 API 令牌。Cookie ID 和 CSRF 各使用32字节 SecureRandom、URL-safe Base64 无填充。 每次请求先恢复候选会话，再在 TaskService 当前账号目录下核验用户存在、可用且目录修订一致。任何目录修改严格撤销全部旧会话；任务提交继续经过已有 currentActor 版本校验。显式 Bearer 不回退 Cookie，双有效身份不一致拒绝；审计继续保存认证身份与结果，不保存认证材料。 以后共享后端必须实现原子有界创建、到期/触摸/撤销和强一致权限重验，同时与共享账号、审计及节点命令权威状态整合。仅把此接口换成某个 Map 或挂载共享文件夹不能关闭 SE-04。共享控制状态完整接口/迁移协议留到 CP-02 设计，不以空壳接口计为实现。 HTTP 与页面合同 POST /api/session 仅接受 Bearer，GET /api/session 支持 Bearer 或 Cookie，POST /api/session/logout 只接受 Cookie。默认生产 Cookie 使用 Host 前缀、Secure、HttpOnly、SameSite=Strict、Path=/、不设置 Domain；本地 HTTP 显式使用不同 Cookie 名。反向代理 publicOrigin 为精确外部 Origin，程序不信任 forwarded 头；Cookie 写请求必须同时通过 Origin/CSRF 检查。生产 TLS 由代理终止。 页面启动不读保存的令牌：先恢复服务器会话和权限，失效再显示登录框。语言是唯一持久 Web Storage 数据。每个 API 请求记录页面会话代次，迟到响应不能改写新会话；状态刷新锁也以代次隔离，旧刷新不会阻塞新登录。 登录、退出和自身令牌轮换后的重新认证经同一认证队列执行。退出立即清界面，再等待已发登录结束，取当前 CSRF 并撤销其 Cookie；这包括晚到登录响应。BroadcastChannel 只广播退出信号，接收方同样清理并排队撤销，不广播认证材料。服务端退出失败显示可重试的双语提示。自身令牌轮换成功后可以用刚确认保存的新令牌自动换取全新会话；旧会话仍失效。 验收边界 - 服务端8项真实 HTTP 合同测试：刷新恢复、Origin/CSRF 拒绝、角色约束、身份冲突、不回退、全目录撤销、轮换/停用/授权变化、自身轮换、关闭会话功能、控制器重启失效、期限/容量与配置校验。 - 同一候选 JAR 上 Java8/11/17/21/25 各运行上述8项；这是会话专项，不能替代全源/目标/JDK矩阵。 - TLS 代理 + 实际 CookieJar：HTTPS 发送 Cookie、HTTP 不发送 Secure 凭证、CSRF/Origin 拒绝、退出后旧 Cookie 不可重放、Bearer 兼容、状态中无明文会话/令牌。 - DOM 覆盖刷新/新页面、退出、跨标签页、迟到401/登录/刷新、服务端退出失败、自身令牌轮换；保留原编辑器/审计/校验/修复测试。 - 制品门禁、根构建及制品优先应用测试、Helm/原生清单一致性和更新后的 Docker 预览另行归档。 真实浏览器视觉/可访问性、真实 Kubernetes/CSI、多控制实例/共享会话、OIDC及人机空闲检测仍未验收。不会用本轮测试关闭这些历史欠项。

title: Shared access design
text: SE-04 / CP-05: shared identity, sessions and audit 中文. This is an implementation contract; requirements stay open until acceptance. Explicit cluster.sharedAccess enables SQL account/session/audit authority while preserving default standalone/registry behavior. It does not turn local task pages into global control; CP-02/03 provide that separately. Bootstrap imports a verified managed-account snapshot or configured accounts. Bind a separate shared-store identity and cluster identity into an upgraded local state format. Old software/disabling shared authority must refuse fallback to stale local grants. Missing/changed store identity and conflicting directories fail startup; existing shared accounts are never overwritten by old bootstrap tokens. Keep pre-import local audit history and an import anchor without rewriting historical chains. Every authentication/grant/session check consults shared authority. Account mutation, directory-wide session revocation and account audit commit atomically with revision/request receipts. Session creation locks/checks the current account revision. Cookie IDs remain opaque/random; SQL retains only digests and minimal principal/CSRF/expiry data. Database time governs expiry and member policy settings must match. Closing one controller does not clear shared sessions. A login can resume at B after A restarts; logout/disable/rotation revoke old credentials everywhere. Bearer and Origin/CSRF rules remain. Shared audit uses a serialized sequence/hash chain and retention anchor. Retry the same event ID idempotently and reject payload collisions. Drain local durable outboxes only after shared confirmation. Preserve/export pre-import local history separately. Acceptance requires independent directories sharing SQL: A-login/B-restore, kill-A/B-continuity, logout/rotation/grant revocation across nodes/restart, no local fallback during store failure, import/identity-loss/rollback refusal, concurrent account/session/audit and expiry/capacity/idempotency contracts, native PG/MySQL, UI and bilingual recovery docs. Full CP-05 also requires least-privilege task-secret distribution and cannot close based on shared accounts alone. SE-04 accepted; CP-05 remains partial. Evidence.

title: 共享访问设计
text: SE-04 / CP-05：共享身份、会话和审计合同 English。此合同的SE-04范围已验收，CP-05部分完成；见证据。 通过显式 cluster.sharedAccess 选项启用SQL共享账号权威、会话与审计。默认单机/目录档案不改变；该选项并不把本机任务页自动变为全局控制。全局任务与命令另由CP-02/03实现。 首次初始化可导入当前已验证的托管账号快照，或以部署账号引导共享目录。保存独立的共享存储身份，并在本机控制状态中持久绑定cluster/store身份，升级状态格式，旧程序或关闭共享选项时拒绝回退为旧本地授权。共享库缺失/身份变化/目录冲突拒绝启动；已存在共享目录不被启动配置中的旧令牌覆盖。迁移前备份本地状态和审计；原有历史保留在本地，并记录导入锚点，不伪造同一条历史链。 每次认证、权限重验、账号修改和会话恢复查询共享权威，不以本地缓存或黏性会话代替一致性。账号变更、全目录会话撤销和账号变更审计在同一SQL事务提交；保留修订、请求ID及回执检查。创建会话时锁定账号修订，拒绝已撤销的身份快照。 Cookie仍为不可读的随机会话ID；共享库只保存其摘要及最小身份/CSRF/期限数据。期限使用数据库时间；相同共享会话策略在所有成员核验，跨节点时钟差不延长权限。控制器关闭仅释放本地连接，不清空其他节点仍在使用的共享会话。节点重启、请求从A转到B可恢复；退出/停用/轮换后B拒绝旧会话。API Bearer、Origin/CSRF规则保留。 共享审计采用数据库锁定的序号/哈希链与保留锚点。HTTP及新任务审计按同一事件ID重试，不能因跨节点重试重复写或忽略不同载荷。原本机持久outbox在共享审计确认后才清理；故障时拒绝宣称已经完成。导入前本地历史保留并单独导出，不重写旧载荷。 验收：两个独立控制目录、共享SQL、A登录/B恢复；杀掉A后B继续认证；在B退出/轮换/改权限，A和重开节点拒绝旧凭据；共享存储中断不得回退到本地账号或内存会话；目录导入、存储身份丢失和旧程序回退拒绝；并发账号/会话/审计、期限/容量和幂等事务检查；真实PG/MySQL档案、UI与双语恢复说明。完整CP-05还包括任务密钥最小下发，不能只凭共享账号标为全部完成。

title: Implementation plan
text: Design boundaries,decisions and delivery order RM-SDD-001 · v0.5 · 2026-11-17 · IMPLEMENTING: single-controller sessions accepted Spec · Tasks · Acceptance · 中文 Baseline The v0.1 inventory is retained as the historical starting baseline. v0.2 implements single-controller sessions;the current candidate and limited five-JDK session matrix are in session evidence. Docker preview is updated;original TODO stays unchanged. v0.1 historical SHA256: 10d95a3990835f2286f036b962d88fc8533ade427753ad9961ef1429988a88e2 .207root cases (205app+2SDK),205actual-JAR-first app and49DOM pass. Repair profiles use LOCAL/H2 and external MySQL/PostgreSQL/openGauss journals with MySQL8.4/PostgreSQL17 business destinations. Full LOCAL and focused external coverage differ;see evidence. These results do not establish cluster control,persistent sessions,skipping or new source adapters. Area Existing foundation Remaining --- --- --- Cluster Worker leases/epochs,owner,isolated tasks,some takeover evidence Global authority,node inventory,remote commands,shared access/session and control HA Login Local accounts,Bearer tokens,grants/audit Reload recovery and server-session lifecycle;current startup clears token/session Recovery Retry,COMMON CUT reconciliation/reviewed repair,native SQL receipts Failed-transaction compensation,manual patches,skip and gap ledger MySQL Basic5.7,historical8.0 V2/HA,representative8.4 V3 Current four-version profiles,especially dedicated8.2 work PG/Oracle sources Neutral interfaces and planned catalog entries Native snapshot/CDC handoff,recovery,UI/API and evidence Java Java8 baseline,old ten-profile SQL matrix Current complete platform,drivers/SDKs and fault profiles on five JDKs Docs Bilingual guides/FAQ/archives New workflows,unified matrices and release gates The historical JDK matrix uses SHA256 2985bbbb51b84ec8de97d8a9b44c88d5a5a1d737032b1e13263d03d4a9134aa0 ,not the current binary. It covers one keyed ASCII MySQL-to-PG path with two journal modes,not all connectors. Original matrix. Request traceability User item SDD range Incomplete items --- --- --- 1 Unified cluster control CP-01–CP-07 7 2 Persistent login SE-01–SE-05 5 3 Skip and corrective data RC-01–RC-10 10 4 Source versions/PG/Oracle SO-01–SO-07 7 5 Five Java versions JV-01–JV-04 4 6 Complete docs DO-01–DO-05 5 Preserved previous scope LG-01–LG-10 10 48items total:6DONE,9NEW and33PARTIAL;42remain open. PARTIAL means foundations exist but the whole requirement is incomplete,not that accepted features must be rebuilt. Confirmed scope Unified multi-node management must control remote tasks from any entry,not just aggregate local pages. Login survives reload with effective logout/revocation. Reviewed manual skip/corrective data are required while automatic recovery remains no-skip by default. MySQL5.7/8.0/8.2/8.4,PostgreSQL and Oracle sources are committed scope rather than optional future placeholders. Java8/11/17/21/25 require real runtime evidence. Complete bilingual scenarios/FAQ and all earlier destination,mapping,optional-storage,deployment and migration requirements remain. Proposed cluster architecture Separate logical management entry,shared control authority,node agents/workers and source-journal/destination protocols. Control metadata,sessions and CDC journal are different concepts;they may share a suitable SQL instance in separate namespaces or use separate deployments. Standalone mode need not acquire an independent journal service. Global node/task IDs,revisions and grants come from authoritative cluster state. Agents execute durable typed/idempotent commands bound to owner generation;local ProcessBuilder is no longer the sole execution channel. Remote interfaces do not expose arbitrary host shells. Distinguish accepted,queued,executing,confirmed,rejected,failed and unknown outcomes;timeouts do not prove a stop. Stale owners and delayed commands are fenced. Report/plan/raw-event/secret locations need ownership and integrity references. Local-only logs/reports pin placement to a recoverable node/volume unless actual reachability is established;moving only a cursor is invalid. Standalone embedded state remains a profile;multiple controllers need verified shared authority/session semantics. Agent lifecycle is separated from console shutdown under an explicit continuation/pause policy. Candidate entities are Cluster,Node (incarnation/heartbeat/capabilities/resources),Task (source/targets/revision/owner),Command (request/grants/expectations/result),Session,RecoveryPlan and ConsistencyGap. Final schemas/backends/protocols are follow-up designs,not existing APIs. Proposed login persistence Preserve API tokens but exchange browser login for a revocable short-lived server session. Prefer a protected cookie inaccessible to page script with production HTTPS and CSRF/Origin checks rather than writing a long-lived administrator token to localStorage. OWASP session guidance. Restore session/grants before loading tasks;controllers share authority. Logout,disable,rotation and permission revocation invalidate appropriately. Bearer APIs remain compatible and identity conflict rules are explicit. Idle/absolute expiry,remembering across browser closure and OIDC are configurable policy decisions;this inventory does not invent a confirmed duration or mandatory two-person approval. Recovery semantics Action Meaning Progress/data boundary --- --- --- Retry Replay the original transaction Resolve uncertain commit before more writes Existing COMMON CUT repair Correct historical differences Remain paused;old report retains differences Pending failed-transaction compensation Restore initial affected identity state Preserve original event,occurrence IDs,PK moves and ordering;do not prematurely count source transaction as applied Pending manual patch Reviewed typed destination edits No implicit source writes;review before/after/counts and refuse drift/dependency violations Pending destination skip Omit one complete known transaction for selected targets Native SKIP receipt plus gap ledger;coverage may advance while applied progress remains honest Pending capture-range quarantine/exclusion Separate plan before complete event formation Identify every affected subscriber and retain raw logs;unprovable boundaries are refused with log/valid-source/rebaseline recovery alternatives Replica-like operation is a UX/recovery requirement,not a command-copy requirement. MySQL differentiates GTID and non-GTID skipping:official guidance. Rivomesh needs its own audited heterogeneous receipt/gap protocol,not source empty-transaction injection,gtid executed editing or a universal sql replica skip counter wrapper. Committed destinations with lagging journal ACK must recover acknowledgment,not compensate or invent an unapplied skip. Destination skip scope is independent;capture exclusion may affect all relevant targets and must declare that scope. Analytical/queue adapters require their own verified protocol rather than SQL transaction promises. A proposed gap record links source/range,transaction/raw/normalized hashes,target scope,reason,actor/approval,original evidence,receipts and subsequent validation. Open,in-remediation,verified resolution and explicitly accepted loss are distinct;accepted loss is not equality. Final enums/transitions are pending design. Source and runtime profiles Source Existing scope Remaining --- --- --- MySQL5.7 Basic5.7.44 evidence Current V3 objects/recovery/HA/runtime profile MySQL8.0 Historical8.0.46 V2/HA Current V3/new recovery acceptance MySQL8.2 No dedicated complete evidence found New profile,compatibility differences and native tests MySQL8.4 Representative V3/recovery Broader auth/log/topology/target/JDK matrix PostgreSQL PLANNED source Snapshot/LSN/slot,transactions,promotion;PG sink support is unrelated Oracle PLANNED source Capture route/version/grants/distribution,SCN/redo/archive,types and recovery PG slot snapshot export binds baseline/stream position;recovery can resend events and needs dedup. Promotion depends on exact version and slot conditions:logical decoding,failover. Oracle identity/incarnation cannot be reduced to one SCN number:Oracle19 LogMiner fields. These are design references,not implemented source claims. Runtime evidence binds candidate SHA,actual JVM/architecture,driver,source profile,destination,journal,auth/TLS and workload. Each approved source profile crosses five JDKs for snapshot,CDC,restart and content checks. Four MySQL profiles plus one PG and one Oracle profile imply at least30source/JDK baseline combinations,not the total target,type,HA or security matrix. Show unrun,failed,experimental and unsupported separately. Proposed sequencing Milestone Work Exit --- --- --- M0 this change Requirements,gaps,tasks,acceptance,evidence baseline 48traceable IDs and documentation checks M1 Session and shared-state contracts;fix reload persistence SE-01/02/03 and standalone compatibility;storage abstraction remains extensible M2 Nodes,remote commands,grants/audit,control HA/session continuity Two-node control,partition/stale-owner/controller-failure acceptance M3 Failed inspection,gap ledger,SQL-first skip/compensation/patches Reviewed boundaries,refusals,receipt recovery,UI/docs;other adapters are not mislabeled supported M4 Four MySQL profiles and PG source Candidate/runtime/object/recovery gates per profile M5 Oracle and more vendor/storage/runtime/deployment profiles Native version/grants/data evidence with explicit PDB/RAC scope M6 Earlier backlog,cutover,live K8s,capacity/soak/release gates Function,migration,bilingual docs and unambiguous evidence per requirement The user subsequently authorized implementation;this ordering is not a delivery-date promise. Common session/source contracts may progress independently;not every phase must be strictly serial. Open details without reopening confirmed scope Control-store product/HA,agent enrollment/auth and standalone upgrade;session expiry/browser-closure/identity policy;exact initial PG versions/database-schema scope and slot failover;Oracle version/capture/CDB-PDB-RAC/storage/distribution;initial recovery profiles,large-event retention and safe capture-range exclusion;Linux architecture,liveK8s/CSI/vendor hardware and benchmark resources. These are profile/policy details,not reasons to ask again whether already-confirmed features are wanted. No universal TPS/RTO number is invented. Definition of done A requirement closes only with linked design/task/API/UI,positive/refusal/duplicate/crash tests,state/config migration,bilingual docs and the same candidate artifact evidence. Build success is not connector acceptance;static YAML is not liveK8s;DOM/HTTP is not visual/accessibility acceptance. This inventory does not mark48runtime requirements implemented. Current increment: SE-01/02/03/04/05 complete; CP-05 partial. Global tasks/remote execution and the remainder of M1/M2 are open. See session design,operations and evidence. CP-01 registry now passes native PostgreSQL/MySQL two-node and outage profiles. Global task/command/identity/session authority remain open. Registry evidence. v0.5 closes SE-04; shared sessions do not depend on global task configuration, so its dependency changes to CP-01. Temporary native/Docker acceptance replaces a persistent preview. Evidence. v0.5: CP-02/03 PARTIAL · Internal foundations evidence. Public runtime integration remains open.

title: 实施计划
text: 设计边界、决策和实施顺序 RM-SDD-001 · v0.5 · 2026-11-17 · 实施中：单控制器会话已验收 规格 · 任务 · 验收 · English 1. 当前基线和核对范围 v0.1整理作为历史起点保留。v0.2已实现单控制器会话，候选包与五JDK会话专项见证据；Docker预览已更新，原TODO保持原样。 v0.1整理时的发布包 SHA256： 10d95a3990835f2286f036b962d88fc8533ade427753ad9961ef1429988a88e2 。对应207项根构建测试（205应用+2 SDK）、205项发布包优先应用测试、49项DOM；新修复场景覆盖 LOCAL/H2、外部 MySQL/PostgreSQL/openGauss 日志，业务目标为 MySQL8.4/PostgreSQL17。完整 LOCAL 与外部修复专项范围不同，见证据。这些结果不能当成新增集群、会话、跳过或新源端已经完成。 方向 已有基础 尚缺的核心 --- --- --- 多节点 Worker租约/epoch、owner、独立任务进程、部分接管验证 全局节点/任务权威状态、远端命令、统一权限/会话、控制面HA 登录 本地账号、Bearer令牌、任务授权与审计 刷新恢复及服务器会话生命周期；目前页面初始化为 token/session 空值 人工恢复 原事务重试、共同校验点对账与审阅修复、SQL本地凭据 失败事务审阅/补偿、手工补丁、事务跳过及缺口台账 MySQL源 5.7基础、8.0历史V2/HA、8.4代表性V3链路 当前统一发布的四条版本档案；8.2专项实现/实测缺失 PG/Oracle源 中立事件/位置接口及规划目录 原生采集、全量衔接、故障恢复、UI/API和实际证据 Java Java8代码基线；旧发布包五JDK×两日志的SQL冒烟 当前完整平台、全部驱动/SDK和故障场景跨JDK验收 文档 较多双语手册、FAQ和归档 全局控制/会话/人工恢复/新源的完整说明、统一矩阵、发布门禁 历史 JDK 矩阵的包 SHA 为 2985bbbb51b84ec8de97d8a9b44c88d5a5a1d737032b1e13263d03d4a9134aa0 ，与当前包不同。其范围仅为单 MySQL 源→PostgreSQL 主键ASCII表、LOCAL/外部PG日志，不能转标成当前全连接器兼容。见运行时原始矩阵。 本次六项要求的追踪映射 用户项 SDD范围 未完成项数 --- --- --- 1 多节点统一控制 CP-01～CP-07 7 2 登录保持 SE-01～SE-05 5 3 跳过与补数据 RC-01～RC-10 10 4 源版本/PG/Oracle SO-01～SO-07 7 5 五个Java版本 JV-01～JV-04 4 6 完整文档 DO-01～DO-05 5 既有范围合并保留 LG-01～LG-10 10 共48项：6项DONE，余42项为9项NEW、33项PARTIAL。PARTIAL表示已有基础但本项整体未完成；不是把已验收功能删除重做。 2. 用户已明确的需求，不再当作可选项 1. 同一平台多节点统一管理，任一管理入口能看到并控制远端任务，不能只聚合几个本机界面。 2. 登录状态刷新后保持；退出、失效和权限撤销仍必须有效。 3. 遇到同步故障，有经审阅的人工跳过、补数据及重试路径；普通自动恢复继续默认不跳过。 4. 源端必须纳入 MySQL5.7/8.0/8.2/8.4、PostgreSQL、Oracle；PG/Oracle从“未来预留”升级为本次承诺范围。 5. Java8/11/17/21/25都要有实际运行证据，不能只看编译级别或镜像标签。 6. 完整中英文文档、场景和FAQ；既有多库显式映射、同源多目标、产品覆盖、可选日志、四类部署和信创改造目标继续保留。 3. 多节点设计提案 建议拆分统一管理入口、共享控制状态、节点Agent/Worker和源日志/目标应用协议。控制元数据、会话和源日志不是同一概念，可在合适SQL实例上分命名空间复用，也可独立部署；不强制所有单机部署新增独立日志服务。 - 统一入口 ：Web/API/CLI面向一个逻辑集群。节点ID、任务ID、任务修订和权限在集群范围有明确权威状态。 - Agent执行 ：控制器提交有类型、可去重、带代次的持久命令；当前owner或被授权Agent执行。控制器本机 ProcessBuilder 不再是唯一执行通道。远端接口只提供授权生命周期/任务操作，不提供任意主机Shell。 - 命令结果 ：区分已接受、排队、执行、确认、失败、拒绝、结果未知。超时或网络分区不能直接显示“已停止”；未知结果需用同一请求ID核对。 - 隔离 ：集群注册代次与任务租约/epoch联合验证。旧owner复活或命令延迟到达时拒绝写入，不能仅依赖心跳或副本数。 - 存储位置 ：计划、报告、原始事件和密钥使用带归属/校验的引用。若日志或报告仅本地存在，任务需绑定节点/可恢复卷，不能在其他节点只恢复一个游标就继续。 - HA边界 ：单机嵌入式配置继续存在；多控制实例需共享权威状态和会话，或经过验证的等效一致性方案。管理实例退出与Agent执行进程生命周期分离，具体继续/暂停策略写入部署档案。 候选逻辑实体：Cluster、Node（incarnation、心跳、能力、资源）、Task（源/目标、修订、owner代次）、Command（请求ID、权限、期望状态、执行回执）、Session、RecoveryPlan、ConsistencyGap。字段、后端和协议的最终详细设计仍待后续规格增量确认，不能把这些名称当成现有API。 4. 登录保持提案 保留已有API令牌能力，浏览器登录后换取可撤销的短期服务器会话；建议使用不暴露给页面脚本的受保护cookie，生产经HTTPS传输，配套CSRF/Origin防护。不能将长期管理员令牌写入localStorage来完成刷新保持。OWASP会话管理说明。 页面启动先恢复会话及权限，再加载任务；多实例请求共享会话权威状态。退出、账号停用、轮换和权限撤销应触发相应失效。CLI/API Bearer方式继续可用，身份冲突规则需明确。空闲/绝对期限、浏览器关闭后是否记住登录、是否接入OIDC属于策略配置；本次不擅自把某个时长或双人审批定为用户已确认要求。 5. 人工恢复边界 操作 语义 进度与数据约束 --- --- --- 重试 重新执行原事务 不改原事件；不确定提交先核对目标回执 共同校验点修复（已有） 在共同历史点修复差异 完成后仍暂停；历史报告不改写为MATCH 失败事务补偿（待做） 恢复受影响身份的事务前状态，再允许重放 保留原事务、无主键ROW ID、主键移动及重复变更顺序；补偿不提前算原事务成功 手工补数据（待做） 审阅的类型化目标数据补丁 默认只写目标；前后状态/行数可审阅；漂移、依赖和权限不符拒绝 目标事务跳过（待做） 对指定目标不应用一整个已知事务 生成SKIP凭据和一致性缺口，安全覆盖进度可前进，但不得伪装为已应用 采集范围隔离/排除（待做） 针对采集/解码未完成处的独立缺口计划 影响全部相关订阅；必须证明范围边界、留存原日志；无法证明则拒绝并引导日志恢复/合格源/新基线 “类似MySQL从库操作”指操作体验和可恢复性，不是照搬数据库服务器命令。MySQL官方也区分GTID与非GTID的跳过方式，参见事务跳过。Rivomesh是异构同步服务，应使用自己的可审计回执和缺口协议，不向源库注入空事务、不直接修改源 gtid executed ，也不把 sql replica skip counter 当作跨产品通用实现。 目标已提交而日志ACK落后时，应恢复确认，不能把已经生效的数据再标记为“未应用跳过”。一个目标跳过不应隐式影响其他目标。采集层排除则可能影响全部相关目标，审批范围必须明确。消息队列/分析库按各自可验证协议实现，不承诺它们具备SQL本地跨表事务。 缺口建议记录：源身份/坐标范围、事务和原始/规范化摘要、目标范围、原因、操作者/批准、原事件位置、SKIP/补偿回执、后续对账和处置状态。OPEN、修复中、已验证修复、已明确接受丢失应区分；“接受丢失”不能显示成“完全一致”。最终枚举和状态迁移为待实施设计。 6. 源端及Java兼容性验收口径 源 现状 未完成要求 --- --- --- MySQL5.7 5.7.44基础链路证据 当前V3对象/恢复/HA及运行时档案补齐 MySQL8.0 8.0.46历史V2/HA等证据 当前发布V3和新增恢复能力补验 MySQL8.2 未发现专项完整证据 新增版本档案、实现差异和实测 MySQL8.4 代表性V3/恢复已验收 扩展认证、日志特性、拓扑、目标和JDK矩阵 PostgreSQL SOURCE目录为PLANNED 一致性快照/LSN/逻辑槽、事务和源切换；PG目标支持不算源支持 Oracle SOURCE目录为PLANNED 路线、版本、权限及分发条件；SCN/redo/归档、事务、类型及恢复 PG使用复制槽导出快照与流位置衔接；槽恢复可能重发，因此需去重。主备续传能力与确切版本及槽同步条件有关，不能泛化到全部版本。PG逻辑解码、PG故障切换。Oracle方案须区分源数据库及incarnation，不能只存一个数字SCN，见Oracle19 LogMiner会话字段。以上为设计依据，不是新增连接器已经实现。 Java矩阵必须绑定候选包SHA、实际JVM/架构、驱动、源版本/模式、目标、日志、权限/TLS与负载。每个批准的源档案至少与五JDK执行全量、增量、重启和内容验证。若首批为四条MySQL版本档案+一个PG档案+一个Oracle档案，最低为30个“源档案×JDK”基线组合；这不是所有目标、类型、HA和安全用例的总数。更细矩阵按已批准档案扩展，未跑/失败/实验/不支持状态必须分别展示。 7. 建议实施顺序，不是工期承诺 阶段 工作 退出条件 --- --- --- M0 当前轮 规格、差距、任务、验收与证据基线 48项ID/依赖/任务/验收可追踪，文档一致性检查通过 M1 会话与共享控制状态接口；先解决刷新保持 SE-01/02/03及单机兼容通过；共享后端接口不锁死本地会话 M2 节点注册、远端命令、权限/审计、控制HA和会话连续性 两节点同一入口控制、分区/旧owner/控制器故障测试通过 M3 失败事务检查、缺口台账、先SQL目标事务跳过及补偿/补数据 明确边界、拒绝不安全操作、凭据恢复、UI与文档闭环；其他目标不能伪标支持 M4 MySQL四版本档案与PG源 当前候选包与对应JDK/对象/恢复矩阵逐项通过 M5 Oracle源及更多厂商/日志/运行时/部署档案 真实版本/权限/数据集证据，标明PDB/RAC等范围 M6 历史欠项、接管切换、实机K8s、容量/长稳及发布门禁 各需求有功能、迁移、双语文档和不可混淆的验证记录 会话基础和源SPI设计可以并行分支推进，但先有规格与状态/协议合同；用户后续已授权开始实现；表中顺序不要求每个阶段只能串行。 8. 待细化决策（不重复询问已确定范围） - 集群控制后端首批支持产品、HA拓扑及Agent认证/注册方式；本地与共享档案如何升级。 - 会话空闲/绝对时限、浏览器关闭后记住登录、外部身份方式；这些是可配置策略，不影响先写接口和验收。 - PG首批确切版本、每任务database/schema范围及切主槽方案；Oracle首批版本、LogMiner/XStream路线、CDB/PDB/RAC/存储和驱动分发条件。 - 首批人工恢复的目标/日志档案、超大原事件保留位置和支持的受控源范围排除方式；未知边界始终不能假装已成功。 - Linux架构、真实K8s/CSI、厂商集群、硬件/网络/存储档案及压测资源；不编造统一TPS或恢复秒数。 9. SDD完成标准 需求ID关联设计、任务、API/UI、正向/拒绝/重复/中断测试、配置/状态升级、双语文档与同一候选包证据后才可标完成。构建通过不代表连接器通过；静态YAML不代表K8s实机通过；DOM/HTTP不代表视觉或可访问性通过。仅完成本轮整理不能把48项待办改为已实现。 当前增量：SE-01/02/03/04/05已完成，CP-05部分完成。全局任务/远端执行及M1/M2其余部分保持未完成。见会话设计、操作手册和证据。 CP-01节点目录现已通过真实PostgreSQL/MySQL双节点及中断档案。全局任务/命令/身份/会话权威仍未完成。目录证据。 v0.5验收关闭SE-04；共享会话不依赖全局任务配置实现，依赖调整为CP-01。无常驻预览，使用临时原生/Docker验收。 Evidence. v0.5: CP-02/03 PARTIAL · Internal foundations evidence. Public runtime integration remains open.

title: Requirements
text: Rivomesh SDD requirements and incomplete scope RM-SDD-001 · v0.6 · 2026-11-17 · IMPLEMENTING Implementation in progress:48 tracked requirements,6 DONE,42 open (9 NEW,33 PARTIAL). SE-04 shared sessions accepted; CP-05 partial; global task authority/remote execution remain open. See shared-access evidence. Baseline/decisions · Tasks · Acceptance · 中文 Unified cluster control ID Priority/status Requirement Gap --- --- --- --- CP-01 P0 / DONE Global node registry and state Shared registry passes PostgreSQL/MySQL two-node,kill/rejoin and storage-outage acceptance;global task authority/commands remain CP-02/03. CP-02 P0 / PARTIAL Global task/configuration authority Opt-in fixed-owner global HTTP/UI,shared configuration and history are wired;legacy import,complete business and scale acceptance remain open. CP-03 P0 / PARTIAL Durable cross-node command routing Public durable commands,offline STOP,actual multi-target validation/repair and original UNKNOWN upgrade recovery accepted;complete cancellation/fault/migration/capacity matrices remain open. CP-04 P0 / PARTIAL Failover,fencing and placement Worker leases/epochs exist;global scheduling,remote lifecycle and rolling-upgrade protocols do not. CP-05 P0 / PARTIAL Shared authorization,audit and secret references Shared accounts/grants/hash-chained audit and Worker environment filtering exist; complete remote correlation, least-secret references and process/filesystem isolation remain open. CP-06 P1 / PARTIAL Cluster logs,metrics and diagnostics Global observations,owner/unknown state,pagination and maintenance results exist;complete node/target filters,remote logs and diagnostics search remain open. Worker process liveness versus journal-claim readiness needs clearer presentation. CP-07 P0 / DONE Control-plane HA and worker independence Protocol4 separated profile accepted on PG/MySQL control stores,all-controller loss/pending-command recovery,store outage,same-Worker continuation and nonroot runtime;default combined remains coupled and failover/other storage-adapter profiles are separate. Persistent login ID Priority/status Requirement Gap --- --- --- --- SE-01 P0 / DONE Session survives page reload Single-controller reload/new-page restoration complete;cross-controller continuity remains SE-04. SE-02 P0 / DONE Session expiry,logout and revocation Expiry,logout,directory-revision revocation and optional browser persistence complete;memory sessions expire on controller restart. SE-03 P0 / DONE Secure session transport and CSRF protection Protected cookies,Origin/CSRF and real TLS-proxy acceptance complete;the proxy terminates production TLS. SE-04 P0 / DONE Session continuity across controllers Shared SQL sessions passed two-controller HTTPS/revocation/kill/reopen/store-outage acceptance on PostgreSQL/MySQL; global task control remains CP-02/03. SE-05 P1 / DONE CLI/API compatibility and identity conflicts Bearer compatibility,no-fallback/conflict rules,grant checks,logout races and self-rotation complete. Manual recovery,skip and corrective data ID Priority/status Requirement Gap --- --- --- --- RC-01 P0 / PARTIAL Phase-aware fault classification Error isolation/resume exists without complete skip/compensation diagnostics. RC-02 P0 / PARTIAL Failed-transaction inspection and evidence retention Journal/history details exist but not a full failed-queue transaction review. RC-03 P0 / NEW Skip a complete destination transaction Resume retries the original transaction;manual skipping is absent. RC-04 P0 / NEW Controlled capture/decode gap recovery Destination skipping cannot fix failures before complete events exist. RC-05 P0 / PARTIAL Uncertain commit and checkpoint reconciliation Automatic apply reconciles commits leading ACK;manual recovery has not reused it. RC-06 P0 / NEW Failed-transaction before-image compensation COMMON CUT repair exists but does not reconstruct the failed transaction pre-state. RC-07 P0 / PARTIAL Guided manual corrective data entry Report-driven repair exists without independent failed-transaction/manual patches. RC-08 P0 / NEW Consistency-gap ledger and honest watermarks No durable distinction between applied/skipped history or gap lifecycle. RC-09 P0 / PARTIAL Durable distributed recovery jobs COMMON CUT has local durable operations/receipts;distributed/new modes do not. RC-10 P1 / PARTIAL Destination-specific recovery and retention SQL,analytical and queue consistency protocols differ. Source compatibility ID Priority/status Requirement Gap --- --- --- --- SO-01 P0 / PARTIAL Source protocol and capability configuration Neutral events/positions exist but factories/UI remain MySQL-oriented. SO-02 P1 / PARTIAL MySQL5.7 supported profile 5.7.44 basic evidence does not cover the required current-platform object/recovery/runtime matrix. SO-03 P1 / PARTIAL MySQL8.0 current V3 acceptance Historical8.0.46 V2/HA evidence is not current full V3 acceptance. SO-04 P1 / NEW MySQL8.2 compatibility and acceptance No dedicated complete8.2 native evidence found;8.0/8.4 cannot substitute. SO-05 P1 / PARTIAL MySQL8.4 expanded compatibility Representative8.4 V3/recovery evidence is not every log/auth/topology/destination combination. SO-06 P1 / NEW PostgreSQL source adapter Catalog says PLANNED;a PG sink driver is not a PG source. SO-07 P1 / NEW Oracle source adapter Catalog says PLANNED;no native snapshot/CDC implementation. Java runtime compatibility ID Priority/status Requirement Gap --- --- --- --- JV-01 P0 / PARTIAL Java8/11/17/21/25 runnable releases Java8 baseline and an older ten-profile SQL matrix exist;current full release is not covered. JV-02 P1 / PARTIAL Cross-JDK source/sink/recovery matrix Ten profiles cover one keyed ASCII table/PG sink,not all adapters. JV-03 P1 / PARTIAL Driver isolation,dependencies and TLS compatibility Vendor isolation/artifact checks exist without all-JDK coverage. JV-04 P1 / NEW Multi-JDK deployment and mixed-version upgrades Benchmarks select JREs;production/mixed-cluster upgrade policies are not accepted. Complete documentation ID Priority/status Requirement Gap --- --- --- --- DO-01 P0 / PARTIAL Bilingual traceable SDD baseline This change creates the v0.5 inventory;module designs,spec change control and implementation evidence closure remain open. DO-02 P1 / PARTIAL Deployment and cluster operations docs Existing deployment artifacts do not cover new cluster control/session models. DO-03 P1 / PARTIAL Recovery scenarios and FAQ Existing reconciliation FAQ does not cover new skip,patch and distributed faults. DO-04 P1 / PARTIAL Configuration/API/compatibility and upgrade docs Partial handbooks lack new APIs and a unified profile index. DO-05 P1 / PARTIAL Documentation and evidence release gates Archives/hash/preview checks exist without a complete requirement release gate. Preserved earlier scope ID Priority/status Requirement Gap --- --- --- --- LG-01 P1 / PARTIAL Domestic transactional database matrix Initial openGauss/DM/Kingbase/GBase8c profiles exist;distributed GaussDB,complete OceanBase recovery and GBase8a/8s remain open. LG-02 P1 / PARTIAL Nonempty adoption,constraints,cutover/failback Initial destinations must be empty;repair completion is not cutover. LG-03 P1 / PARTIAL ClickHouse/Doris/Hive production profiles Initial materialization/recovery exists;cluster/security/capacity/JDK/new recovery profiles remain open. LG-04 P1 / PARTIAL Queue cluster and recovery profiles Initial transports exist for all confirmed queues;complete cluster/TLS/capacity coverage is open. LG-05 P0 / PARTIAL Optional storage and cross-node reachability Local/external journals exist;authority/reports/sessions/control-store relocation and HA boundaries are not unified. LG-06 P1 / PARTIAL Live K8s/CSI and node-fault acceptance Helm/native static checks do not establish live-cluster safety. LG-07 P1 / PARTIAL Large catalogs,transactions and hardware standards Small benchmark tools exist;large-transaction/catalog/cache/capacity standards remain incomplete. LG-08 P1 / PARTIAL Historical DDL,types,indexes and state migration Supported objects/index conversion and v2 compatibility exist;full dynamic DDL,types and explicit migration/rollback remain open. LG-09 P1 / PARTIAL Report retention and real-browser acceptance Summaries/details/DOM/HTTP exist;full catalogs,cleanup,visual/accessibility evidence do not. title: Task inventory
text: SDD task backlog RM-SDD-001 · 2026-11-16 Every task requires design/implementation,positive/negative/crash tests,bilingual docs and candidate evidence. The registry and five session tasks are accepted;42tasks remain open. See session evidence. Dependencies guide implementation,not a requirement to block common infrastructure on every vendor profile. Unified cluster control - [x] T-CP-01 · Global node registry and state · P0 · Depends on: none Deliver: With two nodes,any console shows the same IDs,roles,versions/JDK/architecture,capacity,heartbeat age and ownership;stale/unreachable nodes are explicitly marked. Acceptance: AC-CP-01 - [ ] T-CP-02 · Global task/configuration authority · P0 · Depends on: CP-01 Deliver: A task created/edited through A appears at B with the same global revision;IDs are unique within a cluster;independent sources remain isolated and standalone mode remains usable. Acceptance: AC-CP-02 - [ ] T-CP-03 · Durable cross-node command routing · P0 · Depends on: CP-02 Deliver: Any entry controls tasks on B;typed commands cover create/check/lifecycle/retry/validation/repair and carry request ID,revision and owner generation;duplicate delivery is idempotent and acceptance is distinct from execution. Acceptance: AC-CP-03 - [ ] T-CP-04 · Failover,fencing and placement · P0 · Depends on: CP-03, JV-01, LG-05 Deliver: Power loss,partition and stale-node return never permit dual writers;unconfirmed stops remain unknown/fenced;placement respects JDK,adapter,storage reachability and quotas;drain/move preserves progress. Acceptance: AC-CP-04 - [ ] T-CP-05 · Shared authorization,audit and secret references · P0 · Depends on: CP-02 Deliver: Revocation at A is enforced at B;remote actions correlate by request/task/node/plan;secrets are not returned to UI and agents receive only authorized task references. Acceptance: AC-CP-05 - [ ] T-CP-06 · Cluster logs,metrics and diagnostics · P1 · Depends on: CP-01, CP-03, CP-05 Deliver: UI filters node/task/destination status,lag,backlog,logs and errors with observation timestamps and bounded redacted log access. Acceptance: AC-CP-06 - [x] T-CP-07 · Control-plane HA and worker independence · P0 · Depends on: CP-03, CP-05, SE-04 Deliver: Another entry survives controller failure;accepted commands recover;existing workers continue safely under documented policy;replica count/shared files alone are insufficient. Acceptance: AC-CP-07 Persistent login - [x] T-SE-01 · Session survives page reload · P0 · Depends on: none Deliver: Reload/reopening the site restores an unexpired session and permissions without reentering the token;expired sessions return to login without unintended actions. Acceptance: AC-SE-01 - [x] T-SE-02 · Session expiry,logout and revocation · P0 · Depends on: SE-01 Deliver: Idle/absolute expiry is configurable;logout,disable,rotation and revocation invalidate sessions as specified;tabs agree;remembering across browser closure is a separate configurable policy. Acceptance: AC-SE-02 - [x] T-SE-03 · Secure session transport and CSRF protection · P0 · Depends on: SE-01 Deliver: No readable long-lived browser credential;protected cookie/equivalent transport,HTTPS and HttpOnly/SameSite policy are verified;cookie-authenticated mutations enforce CSRF/Origin checks;session IDs never enter URLs/logs. Acceptance: AC-SE-03 - [x] T-SE-04 · Session continuity across controllers · P0 · Depends on: SE-02, SE-03, CP-01 Deliver: Login at A remains valid at B;controller restart/failover follows expiry/recovery policy;revocation propagates as specified without relying on sticky sessions to hide missing state. Acceptance: AC-SE-04 - [x] T-SE-05 · CLI/API compatibility and identity conflicts · P1 · Depends on: SE-03, CP-05 Deliver: Existing API tokens work;conflicting cookie/header identities follow explicit rules;restoration rechecks grants and late responses cannot revive logout;messages are bilingual. Acceptance: AC-SE-05 Manual recovery,skip and corrective data - [ ] T-RC-01 · Phase-aware fault classification · P0 · Depends on: none Deliver: Distinguish source/read,decode,DDL/normalization,apply,ack and journal failures;UI offers only valid retry/compensation/skip/gap-recovery actions for that stage. Acceptance: AC-RC-01 - [ ] T-RC-02 · Failed-transaction inspection and evidence retention · P0 · Depends on: RC-01, CP-05 Deliver: Show source/transaction identity,event range,affected objects/destinations,raw/normalized hashes,before/after-image availability and checkpoints;bounded raw access is authorized and evidence is retained before action. Acceptance: AC-RC-02 - [ ] T-RC-03 · Skip a complete destination transaction · P0 · Depends on: RC-02, RC-05, RC-08 Deliver: For a known next failed transaction,ADMIN reviews destination scope/reason;cross-table events are not split;native SKIP receipt and safe progress commit locally and crash replay never skips another transaction. Acceptance: AC-RC-03 - [ ] T-RC-04 · Controlled capture/decode gap recovery · P0 · Depends on: RC-01, RC-02, RC-08, SO-01 Deliver: Provide a separate verified transaction/source-range quarantine/exclusion plan affecting all relevant subscriptions with original logs retained;unprovable boundaries are refused with log recovery,valid source or rebaseline alternatives;never fabricate successful application. Acceptance: AC-RC-04 - [ ] T-RC-05 · Uncertain commit and checkpoint reconciliation · P0 · Depends on: RC-02 Deliver: If commit leads ACK,verify content and recover acknowledgment instead of compensating or declaring an unapplied skip;identity,generation,epoch,error/config/hash/checkpoint mismatches refuse action. Acceptance: AC-RC-05 - [ ] T-RC-06 · Failed-transaction before-image compensation · P0 · Depends on: RC-02, RC-05 Deliver: Reconstruct initial affected identity state across repeated keys,PK moves,insert/delete chains,keyless occurrences,JSON/generated values;modify only reviewed scope;commit compensation/receipt atomically without rewriting the source transaction/GTID. Acceptance: AC-RC-06 - [ ] T-RC-07 · Guided manual corrective data entry · P0 · Depends on: RC-02, RC-05, RC-06 Deliver: UI offers typed insert/update/delete and import preview;precision,NULL,keys and occurrence IDs are validated;review before/after scope/counts;refuse drift and unsafe keyless bulk edits;no implicit source writes or dependency bypass. Acceptance: AC-RC-07 - [ ] T-RC-08 · Consistency-gap ledger and honest watermarks · P0 · Depends on: RC-02 Deliver: Track skipped transactions/ranges,destinations,reason,actor,hashes and original evidence;separate applied progress,safe coverage and running-with-gaps;only verification evidence closes a gap and accepted loss is not equality. Acceptance: AC-RC-08 - [ ] T-RC-09 · Durable distributed recovery jobs · P0 · Depends on: CP-03, RC-03, RC-06, RC-07 Deliver: Remote plans,approval,cancellation,receipts and evidence locations are traceable;controller/agent kill recovers the same request with idempotent commits/rollback;skip is not cutover approval. Acceptance: AC-RC-09 - [ ] T-RC-10 · Destination-specific recovery and retention · P1 · Depends on: RC-08, LG-03, LG-04 Deliver: Declare recovery capability per adapter;SQL uses local transactions,analytical/queue adapters verified receipts/gap notifications;other subscriptions are not silently skipped and unresolved evidence is retained with backpressure/alerts. Acceptance: AC-RC-10 Source compatibility - [ ] T-SO-01 · Source protocol and capability configuration · P0 · Depends on: none Deliver: Each task declares source type,identity,namespace and version;GTID,LSN and SCN are not interchangeable;UI/preflight follow real capabilities and reject unsupported profiles. Acceptance: AC-SO-01 - [ ] T-SO-02 · MySQL5.7 supported profile · P1 · Depends on: SO-01 Deliver: Pin patch/driver/log settings and verify snapshot-to-CDC,object capabilities,restart/promotion/log loss,supported DDL/recovery with explicit negative cases and independent evidence. Acceptance: AC-SO-02 - [ ] T-SO-03 · MySQL8.0 current V3 acceptance · P1 · Depends on: SO-01 Deliver: Reverify current-release multi-database fan-out,types/generated columns,transactions,ASYNC/MGR,recovery/manual operations with explicit patch/topology scope. Acceptance: AC-SO-03 - [ ] T-SO-04 · MySQL8.2 compatibility and acceptance · P1 · Depends on: SO-01 Deliver: Provide reproducible8.2 environment,version/auth/status/binlog handling and a complete first sync/recovery matrix;string matching/JDBC connectivity alone is insufficient. Acceptance: AC-SO-04 - [ ] T-SO-05 · MySQL8.4 expanded compatibility · P1 · Depends on: SO-01 Deliver: Reverify supported current-release profiles and declare tagged/untagged GTID,anonymous events,row images,compression/partial-JSON capabilities or refusal;version labels are not blanket feature acceptance. Acceptance: AC-SO-05 - [ ] T-SO-06 · PostgreSQL source adapter · P1 · Depends on: SO-01 Deliver: Implement consistent snapshot/LSN handoff,slots/publications,ordering/replay,replica identity,types/DDL and recovery;verify WAL/slot loss/promotion per version;expose GUI/CLI/docs. Acceptance: AC-SO-06 - [ ] T-SO-07 · Oracle source adapter · P1 · Depends on: SO-01 Deliver: Specify capture route,versions,privileges and driver distribution conditions;implement SCN snapshot,commit/rollback,redo/archive,DB identity/incarnation,checkpoint/replay;verify LOB,charset,PDB/RAC scope explicitly. Acceptance: AC-SO-07 Java runtime compatibility - [ ] T-JV-01 · Java8/11/17/21/25 runnable releases · P0 · Depends on: none Deliver: The candidate controller/agent/worker actually starts on all five JDKs with real JVM version,artifact hash,architecture and dependencies recorded;Java8 class/driver requirements are verified. Acceptance: AC-JV-01 - [ ] T-JV-02 · Cross-JDK source/sink/recovery matrix · P1 · Depends on: JV-01, SO-02, SO-03, SO-04, SO-05, SO-06, SO-07 Deliver: Each approved source profile crosses five JDKs for snapshot,CDC,restart and equality;record separate adapter/SDK/TLS/object/cluster/recovery gates and never label unrun combinations passed. Acceptance: AC-JV-02 - [ ] T-JV-03 · Driver isolation,dependencies and TLS compatibility · P1 · Depends on: JV-01 Deliver: Verify service loading,reflection/modules,auth/TLS/certificates,reconnect,precision and vendor minimum JDK;incompatible combinations are explicitly refused,not inferred from compilation. Acceptance: AC-JV-03 - [ ] T-JV-04 · Multi-JDK deployment and mixed-version upgrades · P1 · Depends on: CP-04, JV-02, JV-03, LG-08 Deliver: Provide five-JDK deployment profiles/placement constraints and verify command,event,state and rolling-upgrade compatibility;unsupported downgrade is refused with recovery guidance. Acceptance: AC-JV-04 Complete documentation - [ ] T-DO-01 · Bilingual traceable SDD baseline · P0 · Depends on: none Deliver: Each requirement has stable ID,status,gap,dependencies,priority,acceptance and task;ZH/EN IDs match and changes preserve evidence scope. Acceptance: AC-DO-01 - [ ] T-DO-02 · Deployment and cluster operations docs · P1 · Depends on: CP-07, SE-04, JV-04, LG-05, LG-06 Deliver: Provide runnable standalone/cluster examples for four deployment paths with stores,secrets/TLS,enrollment/drain,backup/restore/upgrades and local-storage boundaries;live K8s requires separate evidence. Acceptance: AC-DO-02 - [ ] T-DO-03 · Recovery scenarios and FAQ · P1 · Depends on: RC-09, RC-10, SE-05 Deliver: Each scenario states symptoms,cause,UI/API steps,positions,gaps,idempotency/undo limits across promotion,log loss,SQL/ack,node/storage,session and manual recovery. Acceptance: AC-DO-03 - [ ] T-DO-04 · Configuration/API/compatibility and upgrade docs · P1 · Depends on: SO-01, JV-02, CP-03 Deliver: Document configuration,grants,codes,request/command/plan versions,source coordinates,consistency and source/sink/JDK profiles with examples/evidence;schema changes update both languages. Acceptance: AC-DO-04 - [ ] T-DO-05 · Documentation and evidence release gates · P1 · Depends on: DO-01, DO-02, DO-03, DO-04, LG-09 Deliver: Check links,examples,APIs and bilingual coverage;completion links candidate hash/native evidence;DOM is not visual,static YAML is not live deployment,and builds are not adapter acceptance. Acceptance: AC-DO-05 Preserved earlier scope - [ ] T-LG-01 · Domestic transactional database matrix · P1 · Depends on: JV-01 Deliver: Record sync/recovery/manual capabilities by product,version,mode,distribution/index/driver/JDK;commercial distributed hardware is separately accepted,not inferred from PG protocol connectivity. Acceptance: AC-LG-01 - [ ] T-LG-02 · Nonempty adoption,constraints,cutover/failback · P1 · Depends on: RC-09, SO-01 Deliver: Implement adoption/difference planning,constraint restoration,final source cut,write handoff and failback conditions;dual-write/bidirectional conflict policy is separately specified. Acceptance: AC-LG-02 - [ ] T-LG-03 · ClickHouse/Doris/Hive production profiles · P1 · Depends on: JV-01 Deliver: Verify visibility,dedup/batch receipts,restart,old-backup,cluster and gaps per product without claiming ordinary SQL cross-table atomicity. Acceptance: AC-LG-03 - [ ] T-LG-04 · Queue cluster and recovery profiles · P1 · Depends on: JV-01 Deliver: Each queue verifies lost confirmations,election,durable receipts,resource loss,consumer dedup/backlog and skip-gap protocol with honest delivery/consumption boundaries. Acceptance: AC-LG-04 - [ ] T-LG-05 · Optional storage and cross-node reachability · P0 · Depends on: CP-02 Deliver: Local mode documents durable volume/pinning/disk-loss limits;external/shared modes are accepted per capability;move verifies logs,evidence,reports and secrets,not just cursors;independent journal infrastructure is not mandatory for every deployment. Acceptance: AC-LG-05 - [ ] T-LG-06 · Live K8s/CSI and node-fault acceptance · P1 · Depends on: CP-04, CP-07, LG-05 Deliver: Verify upgrade/scale,pod/node failure,RWO/CSI remount,secret rotation and stale-owner fencing on a real cluster with published configuration/evidence. Acceptance: AC-LG-06 - [ ] T-LG-07 · Large catalogs,transactions and hardware standards · P1 · Depends on: JV-02, LG-05 Deliver: Bound memory/disk for large transactions/catalogs/slow sinks and publish multi-run hardware/workload results without linear extrapolation or count-only correctness. Acceptance: AC-LG-07 - [ ] T-LG-08 · Historical DDL,types,indexes and state migration · P1 · Depends on: SO-01 Deliver: Preserve schema history/plans and identity keys;publish v2/v3/new control-gap schema migrations,backup/rollback or safe refusal with product-specific limits. Acceptance: AC-LG-08 - [ ] T-LG-09 · Report retention and real-browser acceptance · P1 · Depends on: CP-06, SE-05, RC-09 Deliver: Provide authorized report/receipt search,retention and active-file protection;real browsers verify cluster/session/confirmation/recovery/pagination and accessibility. Acceptance: AC-LG-09 - [ ] T-LG-10 · External identity,immutable audit and Apache preparation · P2 · Depends on: CP-05, SE-05 Deliver: Verify external identity/revocation,external audit and distribution conditions;complete license/NOTICE/SBOM/contribution docs without claiming Apache affiliation or trademark rights. Acceptance: AC-LG-10 v0.4: shared identity/session authority is independent of global task configuration, so SE-04 now depends on CP-01; CP-05 remains partial. Evidence. v0.5: CP-02/03 PARTIAL;6DONE/33PARTIAL/9NEW. Evidence. 2026-11-17: Public fixed-owner routing/CDC evidence; incomplete maintenance projection/migration/HA remain tracked, without changing DONE counts. v0.6: CP-07 separated LOCAL-journal profile accepted;7DONE/33PARTIAL/8NEW. Evidence.

title: 任务清单
text: SDD任务清单 RM-SDD-001 · 2026-11-16 每项任务完成必须包括设计/实现、正反向与中断恢复测试、双语文档和候选包证据。已验收节点目录及5项会话任务，余42项保持未完成；见会话证据。依赖是实施顺序，不表示必须等待所有厂商档案才能开发公共框架。 多节点统一控制 - [x] T-CP-01 · 统一节点注册与状态 · P0 · 依赖：无 交付：部署两个节点后，任一管理入口均显示相同节点ID、角色、版本/JDK/架构、容量、心跳时间和任务归属；失联显示过期/未知，不能伪装成健康。 验收：AC-CP-01 - [ ] T-CP-02 · 全局任务、配置与操作权威状态 · P0 · 依赖：CP-01 交付：同一集群中从A创建/修改任务后B读到同一全局修订；全局taskId唯一，独立任务与源配置仍隔离；单机模式保留可运行配置。 验收：AC-CP-02 - [ ] T-CP-03 · 跨节点持久命令路由 · P0 · 依赖：CP-02 交付：任一入口可控制B的任务：创建、检查、启停、暂停/恢复、重试、校验/修复；命令含全局请求ID/修订/owner代次，重复投递只生效一次，202仅表示接受，返回已执行/拒绝/未知结果。 验收：AC-CP-03 - [ ] T-CP-04 · 故障接管、隔离与资源调度 · P0 · 依赖：CP-03, JV-01, LG-05 交付：节点断电/网络分区/旧节点恢复时同一任务无双写；未确认停机可标记未知并隔离；按JDK、连接器、存储可达性和配额调度；排空迁移保留断点。 验收：AC-CP-04 - [ ] T-CP-05 · 共享权限、审计和密钥引用 · P0 · 依赖：CP-02 交付：从A撤销权限后B拒绝新命令；同一远端操作可按请求ID/任务/节点/计划追踪；界面不返回密钥，节点仅获得授权任务必需的密钥引用。 验收：AC-CP-05 - [ ] T-CP-06 · 全局日志、指标与诊断界面 · P1 · 依赖：CP-01, CP-03, CP-05 交付：界面按节点/任务/目标过滤状态、延迟、积压、日志和错误；注明采集时间及失联范围；远端日志分页/限流且不泄露业务值或凭据。 验收：AC-CP-06 - [x] T-CP-07 · 控制面HA及控制/数据面解耦 · P0 · 依赖：CP-03, CP-05, SE-04 交付：管理实例故障后其他入口可继续查询/控制；接收但未完成的命令可恢复；按明确策略已有Worker可继续安全同步；仅部署多个replica或共享目录不能算通过。 验收：AC-CP-07 登录状态保持 - [x] T-SE-01 · 刷新后恢复登录态 · P0 · 依赖：无 交付：登录后刷新、重新打开同一站点页面可恢复未过期会话和原权限，不需再次输入令牌；过期则回到登录页且不误发操作。 验收：AC-SE-01 - [x] T-SE-02 · 会话期限、退出和撤销 · P0 · 依赖：SE-01 交付：可配置空闲/绝对有效期；退出、账号停用、令牌轮换或权限撤销按策略失效；多标签页一致；浏览器关闭后的持久记住登录为单独可配置策略。 验收：AC-SE-02 - [x] T-SE-03 · 安全会话传输和CSRF防护 · P0 · 依赖：SE-01 交付：浏览器端不保存可读的长期认证令牌；会话标识采用受保护cookie/等效方案，生产HTTPS及HttpOnly/SameSite策略可验证；cookie鉴权写操作具备CSRF/Origin检查；会话不进URL或日志。 验收：AC-SE-03 - [x] T-SE-04 · 跨控制节点的会话连续性 · P0 · 依赖：SE-02, SE-03, CP-01 交付：登录A后请求落到B仍合法；重启/切换控制实例按有效期恢复；集群撤销即时按规定传播，不以粘性会话掩盖状态缺失。 验收：AC-SE-04 - [x] T-SE-05 · CLI/API兼容及身份冲突规则 · P1 · 依赖：SE-03, CP-05 交付：既有CLI/API令牌可继续使用；cookie与Authorization身份冲突有明确拒绝/优先规则；会话恢复重验权限，晚到响应不能复活退出会话，双语提示一致。 验收：AC-SE-05 人工恢复、跳过与补数据 - [ ] T-RC-01 · 按采集阶段区分故障 · P0 · 依赖：无 交付：分别展示源连接/读取、解码、DDL/规范化、目标应用、确认及日志存储错误；UI给出该阶段可用的重试、补偿、事务跳过或缺口恢复路径，不能把所有binlog故障当目标SQL错误。 验收：AC-RC-01 - [ ] T-RC-02 · 失败事务检查与原始证据留存 · P0 · 依赖：RC-01, CP-05 交付：显示源身份、完整事务ID、事件范围、表/目标、原始及规范化摘要、前后镜像可用性和当前断点；原始值仅授权角色可读并分页限额；执行前保留可恢复证据。 验收：AC-RC-02 - [ ] T-RC-03 · 目标应用阶段按完整事务跳过 · P0 · 依赖：RC-02, RC-05, RC-08 交付：对已知边界的下一失败事务，管理员选择目标、原因并审阅后跳过；同一源事务跨表事件不可拆半；目标原生SKIP凭据与安全进度同本地事务，崩溃重放不重复/误跳其他事务。 验收：AC-RC-03 - [ ] T-RC-04 · 采集/解码阶段的受控缺口恢复 · P0 · 依赖：RC-01, RC-02, RC-08, SO-01 交付：单独设计已验证事务/源范围的隔离与排除计划，列出所有受影响订阅并保留原日志；边界或内容无法证明时拒绝执行，提供恢复日志、切换合格源或新基线方案；不能伪造普通应用成功。 验收：AC-RC-04 - [ ] T-RC-05 · 不确定提交与断点核对 · P0 · 依赖：RC-02 交付：若目标已提交但ACK未落盘，先验证事务内容并恢复确认，禁止再次补偿/伪记为未应用跳过；来源、世代、epoch、错误版本、配置、原事务摘要或断点不符必须拒绝。 验收：AC-RC-05 - [ ] T-RC-06 · 失败事务前镜像补偿 · P0 · 依赖：RC-02, RC-05 交付：重建首个受影响身份的事务前状态，正确处理同键多次变更、主键移动、插入后删除、无主键重复行/ROW ID、JSON与生成值；只修补审阅范围；数据与补偿凭据原子提交，原事务和GTID不改写。 验收：AC-RC-06 - [ ] T-RC-07 · 界面手工补数据与修正 · P0 · 依赖：RC-02, RC-05, RC-06 交付：界面提供类型化新增/修改/删除和导入预览；校验精度、NULL、键和内部行身份，禁止无主键误批量修改；计划显示前后值、范围和行数，目标漂移拒绝；不自动修改源库，不绕过外键/触发器保护。 验收：AC-RC-07 - [ ] T-RC-08 · 一致性缺口台账与真实水位 · P0 · 依赖：RC-02 交付：记录每次跳过的事务/范围、目标、原因、操作者、摘要和原事件位置；界面/API区分已应用、安全覆盖及有缺口继续运行；对账/补偿证据才可验证关闭缺口，接受丢失不能伪装成数据一致。 验收：AC-RC-08 - [ ] T-RC-09 · 补偿作业的跨节点持久化和恢复 · P0 · 依赖：CP-03, RC-03, RC-06, RC-07 交付：远端目标的计划、批准、取消、凭据和原始数据位置可追踪；控制/执行节点强杀后以同一请求恢复；已提交不重复、未提交回滚；跳过后不自动宣称业务接管完成。 验收：AC-RC-09 - [ ] T-RC-10 · 多目标恢复语义和回收保护 · P1 · 依赖：RC-08, LG-03, LG-04 交付：为每个目标声明跳过/补偿能力；SQL用本地事务，分析/消息目标用可验证回执/缺口通知；其他目标不被隐式跳过；未修复缺口与待审原事件不被静默GC，配额满时背压告警。 验收：AC-RC-10 源数据库兼容 - [ ] T-SO-01 · 多源协议与能力配置 · P0 · 依赖：无 交付：每任务显式source.type、逻辑源身份、命名空间和版本配置；MySQL GTID、PG LSN、Oracle SCN不能互相比较；向导/预检按实际能力启用，未支持配置明确拒绝。 验收：AC-SO-01 - [ ] T-SO-02 · MySQL 5.7 完整支持档案 · P1 · 依赖：SO-01 交付：固定补丁、驱动、日志配置后验证全量转增量、JSON/无主键/生成列能力、重启/切主/日志缺失、所支持DDL和恢复；不支持项预检拒绝并形成独立证据。 验收：AC-SO-02 - [ ] T-SO-03 · MySQL 8.0 当前V3能力补验 · P1 · 依赖：SO-01 交付：对本次发布包补验多库多目标、类型/生成列、事务、主备/MGR、失败恢复与人工操作；按拓扑和小版本注明范围。 验收：AC-SO-03 - [ ] T-SO-04 · MySQL 8.2 新增兼容与验收 · P1 · 依赖：SO-01 交付：提供可复现8.2夹具/真实环境、版本探测、连接认证、状态命令、binlog事件和首个完整同步/恢复矩阵；不能只增加版本字符串或通过JDBC连接。 验收：AC-SO-04 - [ ] T-SO-05 · MySQL 8.4 扩展兼容与回归 · P1 · 依赖：SO-01 交付：在当前发布包复验已支持档案，列明未标记/带标记GTID、匿名事务、行镜像、压缩/部分JSON等能力支持或拒绝，不把版本名称等同所有特性完成。 验收：AC-SO-05 - title: SDD 文档索引
text: Rivomesh Spec-Driven Development 以需求规格驱动设计、任务、实现与验收。先登记规格与差距，代码和文档变更再关联对应需求ID，最后用候选发布包的真实证据关闭条目。本目录使用可评审的Markdown/JSON，不依赖安装特定SDD工具。 Use specifications to drive design,tasks,implementation and acceptance. Record requirements/gaps first,link subsequent code/docs to requirement IDs,then close them with candidate-release evidence. Markdown/JSON keep this process tool-independent. 基线 / Baseline 入口 / Entry 状态 / State --- --- --- RM-SDD-001 · 多节点、会话、恢复、源/JDK兼容和文档 中文规格 / English v0.3实施中：节点目录+4项会话已验收，43项未完成 / registry+4session requirements accepted,43open 每包包括spec、plan、tasks、acceptance及机器可读requirements.json。NEW/PARTIAL/DONE是实现状态，P0/P1/P2是建议优先级；不能用“规划中”冒充“支持”。 Each package contains spec,plan,tasks,acceptance and requirements.json. NEW/PARTIAL/DONE are implementation states;P0/P1/P2 are proposed priorities. Planned capabilities are never presented as supported.

title: 验证记录汇总
text: 故障与恢复验证 日期：2026-11-15。Java 8，目标为 openGauss 7.0.0-RC3，MySQL 使用官方镜像。 English: Validation and recovery evidence。 本记录保留 v2 单 database/单目标及多配置平台的 HA 矩阵，并继续记录 v3 多库多目标的独立验收。最新 v3 记录见下节。 自动迁移接管、剩余 MQ/分析/其他厂商目标、源 PostgreSQL/Oracle、商业分布式 GaussDB、完整权限/修复工作台仍未完成。V3 Web 多目标向导与独立恢复、RabbitMQ/NATS 发布已经接通，验证范围如下。 后续验收范围见 需求与决策、完整平台方案 和 Gauss 索引策略。 OceanBase 实验适配：完整恢复未通过（2026-11-15） 证据及失败记录：当前包9a087通过118项Java/SDK单元/API测试，另以实际fat JAR通过116项应用测试，31项DOM通过。原生强一致读、跨库回滚、归属/epoch及全量/类型和部分增量已实测。四轮完整联合用例仍有管理DDL超时、业务租户初始化超时或OBD资源预检查拒绝，不能算作完整恢复通过；OceanBase能力目录保持EXPERIMENTAL。所有场景、包版本差异及资源探针均保留，继续定位恢复问题。 Doris SQL 模式和字符校验补充（2026-11-15） 补充证据：目录/回执/行查询改为二进制服务端预编译参数，强制禁止不支持时回退字符串插值。实际发布包11667063通过原生重启及旧备份保护，并新增空 SQL 模式和NO BACKSLASH ESCAPES下的引号/反斜杠表名、Unicode/emoji文本、全量/增量及会话重建。非法UTF-16确定性暂停的分类已通过单元测试。当前发布包9a087又通过真实MySQL8.4.13→PG17.12＋Doris4.1.3完整联合故障恢复用例；14个Doris适配器类与原生模式/旧备份验收包11667063一致，包与范围差异均单独记录。 Doris首批原生及联合恢复（2026-11-15） 归档证据：2项SDK＋114项应用测试、30项DOM通过；最终fat JAR另直接通过114项应用测试（重复执行不相加）。最终包通过原生MoW/索引/PK/无主键/精度/重启及旧非空FE＋BE备份拒绝。真实MySQL8.4→PG17.12＋Doris4.1.3联合链路通过全量/增量、目标故障隔离和自动追平、Worker强杀、SQL约束修复重试、视图丢失隔离及诚实的暂停栅栏。联合包与最终包的全部65114类比较仅能力目录文字不同，运行资源一致。集群/TLS/多JDK/容量/接管/动态DDL等不由此证明。 精确任务授权与最终发布包（2026-11-15） 归档证据：Maven的2项SDK及99项应用测试通过；最终fat JAR另直接运行99项应用测试全部通过，不能将重复执行相加。29项DOM及Helm三种配置的静态检查通过。真实Java8发布包从平台文件加载授权，验证精确/空授权、列表过滤、直接操作拦截和SIGKILL重启后权限保持；该管理用例的数据库后端为桩。相同最终包另通过实际MySQL8.4→PG17.12配置轮换/恢复/重启续传，146条原生审计记录经Python校验。账号管理界面及真实K8s/外部不可变审计不在此验收范围。 全局安全审计（2026-11-15） 归档证据：98项Java/SDK单元/API、28项DOM、7项导出工具测试通过。相同发布包通过Java8真实HTTP/H2、分页导出原生哈希校验、SIGKILL后已提交事件保留及审计库删除拒绝启动；该独立用例的数据库后端为桩。另通过真实MySQL8.4→PG17.12密码轮换/配置恢复/重启增量链路，132条审计事件由Python独立校验。Helm/原生清单通过静态一致性，不代表真实K8s或外部不可变审计。 配置编辑及恢复：最终发布包验收（2026-11-15） 归档证据：88项 Java/SDK 单元及API测试、25项DOM测试无失败。最终发布包在真实 MySQL8.4→PostgreSQL17.12 链路通过停机目标密码轮换、旧凭据检查失败、幂等配置提交、历史版本恢复及删除投影后的控制器重启续传；保留原流/快照身份。真实浏览器外观、其他目标/源账号DDL及完整审计不由此证明。 V3 与新增兼容验证 - MySQL 5.7.44 → openGauss：首轮 28 次执行通过，覆盖 JSON 全量/增量/重启；日志 target/mysql57-base.log 。这不是完整 5.7 HA/MGR 验收。 - 原生 PostgreSQL 17.12 目标：首轮 31 次执行通过；后续事务目标/日志适配器 37 次通过，日志 target/sink-postgres.log 。 GaussDB 的分布键/GSI 不计入已验收。 - MySQL 8.4 新 Source：多 database、无主键重复行、JSON、存储/虚拟生成列及 MVCC 快照测试通过；更新后立即再次修改源数据，仍验证前一事件的历史生成值。 target/v3-mysql-source.log 共 42 次执行通过。 - CLI 完整 v3：MySQL 8.4 → PostgreSQL + openGauss 两个实例，跨 database 原子事务、单目标 SQL 失败隔离、强制终止/重启、PAUSED 保留、原事务恢复、无主键逐出现更新/删除及日志回收。首轮 target/v3-pipeline.log 共 46 次执行通过。后续快照回收、本地 H2 自动服务模式仍在扩展测试中，最终记录另列。 - DOM 向导目前 7 项通过，覆盖 v2/v3、多库多目标、SQL/MQ 配置、密码与令牌遮蔽、独立错误版本恢复；日志 target/message-ui-sasl.log 。没有截图级浏览器验收。 - target/v3-three-targets.log ：26 次通过，扩展为独立 MySQL 8.4、PostgreSQL 17、openGauss 7 三个实例同时接收，外部 PG 与本地 H2 两种日志都覆盖。 - target/v3-ha-fixed.log ：v3 两 Worker 冷启动/接管、MySQL 从库 SQL 线程 1032 错误及错误提升拒绝、真实主库关闭、外部提升从库后自动续传通过；完成快照未重新扫描。 - target/v3-group.log ：三节点 MGR，源 MVCC 快照尚未完成时关闭主库，重新选主后重建未完成快照并追平两目标，通过。v3 的未完成 MVCC 视图重建与 v2 的主键游标恢复策略不同。 -
